titleEn: Successful Pairs of Spells and Potions
title: 咒语和药水的成功对数
summary: 每个咒语可与每瓶药水配对，乘积至少为 success 时成功，返回各咒语对应的成功药水数量。
insight: 排序药水。对咒语 spell，成功药水至少为 ceil(success/spell)，二分找到第一个不小于该阈值的位置，后缀长度就是答案。
pitfalls: 乘积和 success 使用 long
结果顺序与原 spells 一致

solutions.title: 排序后二分成功下界
solutions.idea: 把乘积条件变成药水值的单调阈值。
steps: 对每个 spell 计算 required=ceil(success/spell)

code.java: class Solution { public int[] successfulPairs(int[] spells,int[] potions,long success){Arrays.sort(potions);int[] answer=new int[spells.length];for(int i=0;i<spells.length;i++){long required=(success+spells[i]-1)/spells[i];int left=0,right=potions.length;while(left<right){int middle=(left+right)/2;if(potions[middle]>=required)right=middle;else left=middle+1;}answer[i]=potions.length-left;}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun successfulPairs(spells:IntArray,potions:IntArray,success:Long):IntArray{potions.sort();return IntArray(spells.size){i->val required=(success+spells[i]-1)/spells[i];var left=0;var right=potions.size;while(left<right){val middle=(left+right)/2;if(potions[middle].toLong()>=required)right=middle else left=middle+1};potions.size-left}} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:vector<int> successfulPairs(vector<int>& spells,vector<int>& potions,long long success){sort(potions.begin(),potions.end());vector<int> answer;for(long long spell:spells){long long required=(success+spell-1)/spell;auto iterator=lower_bound(potions.begin(),potions.end(),required);answer.push_back(potions.end()-iterator);}return answer;} };
